avatarSetPosRuntime.scope: Unmodified whole AvatarSetPos::Update 0x100149c40, AvatarBarn local selection/getter 0x1000ff210/0x1000fc260, Avatar::SetPosition 0x100100fb0, Marker forward XYZ 0x10043d900, Euler 0x100146d00 and Event::Start 0x10032ef60. Explicit Marker virtual matrices, inverse/product results, collision/segment/material channel 0x50/filter, rand, handhold group/member/peers and low-level state setters, libc++ logging/stack guard services. Linux libm returns captured and replayed; macOS libm not verified. All nonpointer Event bytes, two full state buffers, Barn moved flag/sequence and dependency arguments/order compared. Prepared allocations/selection flags and 59 serialized flag/Marker transform snapshots do not prove startup selection, actual Marker lifecycle, physics/handhold services, animations or full class/game runtime. Unused Marker-forward SIMD W excluded; copied Euler destination W retained.

avatarLocomotionRuntime.scope: Unmodified whole AvatarLoco 8-iteration collision/slide solver 0x100147230, action placement request 0x100147c70 normal paths and original assertions, whole force queue/default wrapper/export and separate nearby-effect queue/export. All 64KiB state/inputs/alias outputs and ordered collision/log/string/copy service arguments are compared. Collision Move 0x100778220, libc++ log assembly/stack guard and C strings/memcpy are explicit services; scripted collision positions do not prove real collision/shape/filter ownership. Finite XYZ/default MXCSR slide arithmetic, native unused SIMD W retained; complete Avatar per-frame state/animation loading/skinning/blending/map startup and game acceptance remain open. Prepared cases are not actual running map/Avatar instances.

beamoDrawPreview.scope: Recovered packed LOD0 upload and original material shaders in the editor. Full Model/Barn ownership, automatic LOD/Visibility, external weight volumes, skinning and original scene lifecycle remain pending.

avatarPreview.scope: Actual Electron/Vulkan viewport with original unique body/hair/wing geometry, explicit AvatarSetPos selection and separate editor/Avatar cameras. Native physical setter and full Whisker initialization/reset arithmetic integrated with explicit neutral preview offset parameters and JavaScript libm services. Entry eye/pivot use recovered Euler->forward; lookAt/projection/continuous input remain preview. Native 8-iteration AvatarLoco slide is used during motion with the same physical state as placement; triangle/sphere collision, acceleration/gravity, static pose and neutral shading are explicit editor services. Full native camera/physics/skinning/shader/startup behavior pending.

cameraEventRuntime.scope: Whole unmodified SetCameraShake OnStart/Update 0x1003a0ec0/0x1003a0ee0, SetCameraKeyFrameShake OnStart/Update 0x100591d90/0x100591da0, CameraSystem camera-handle acquisition 0x1001e2ac0, original metadata getters and Event::Start 0x10032ef60. Every frame compares event/camera/key-frame/barn nonpointer bytes including paired speed/force copied to Whisker+378/+37c, clump count, reflection order and assertion partial-state captures. Reflected metadata/casts, stack guard and runtime clock/debug snapshots remain services. Missing serialized fields use explicit zero prepared allocations in oracle only. Does not restore constructor defaults, automatic scene/EventBarn dispatch, full metadata cast/handle lifecycle, continuous Whisker/key-frame shake sampling or final camera rendering.

avatarPositionalShake.scope: Whole unmodified Whisker shake/basis helper 0x10073afd0; all 1024 camera bytes, positional offset, 3 basis vectors, Wind input, ordered ray requests and complete whippast sound parameter snapshots compared each frame. Native float expf/powf/cosf/sincos results and packed upper lanes captured/replayed; physical state, Wind samples, four ray results and sound dispatch remain supplied services. Finite inputs with noise conversions inside int32 range only. Negative phases preserve native truncation/unsigned conversion. Ten actual SetCameraShake speed/force configurations are supplied with explicit prepared weight and physical snapshots, not scene startup or constructor defaults. Surrounding Whisker Update, original ray filtering/avoidance, full CameraKeyFrame/CameraGuide, camera lens/projection and macOS libm parity remain unverified.
